solution.title: Windows Firewall GPO to Intune Migration

products.name: Windows Firewall GPO to Intune Migration — Commercial
products.short_description: The controlled Windows Firewall GPO-to-Intune migration — translate rules to Intune endpoint-security firewall policy, manage coexistence to avoid conflicts/loops, and cut over in rings with validation. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move firewall rules from GPO to Intune — without policy conflicts or loops

Migrating Windows Defender Firewall from Group Policy to Intune is a known minefield: do it before the foundation is ready and you get policy conflicts or merge/loop conditions that leave devices in an unpredictable state. This solution is the controlled firewall GPO-to-Intune migration — inventory and translate firewall rules into Intune endpoint-security firewall policy, manage GPO/Intune coexistence to avoid conflicts, and cut over in rings with validation, so the firewall stays correct throughout.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the firewall migration model, mapping GPO firewall rules to Intune endpoint-security firewall policy (and firewall rule profiles), why conflicts/loops happen and how coexistence prevents them, and the ringed cutover.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, the existing GPO firewall rule export, target device groups, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory GPO firewall rules, translate to Intune firewall policy, configure coexistence to avoid conflicts/merge issues, assign in rings, validate connectivity and rule enforcement, retire the GPO firewall settings, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — firewall-rule discovery (GPO + applied), post-migration rule-parity validation, a migration coverage and conflict report, safe remediation of conflicts, and a migration-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Windows Defender Firewall moved from GPO to Intune — rules translated, conflicts and loops avoided through managed coexistence, and cut over in rings with parity validated — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • FWMIG-Discovery.ps1 — Inventory GPO + applied Windows Defender Firewall configuration (READ-ONLY)
    • FWMIG-Remediation.ps1 — Safely resolve firewall double-management / conflicts (default -WhatIf)
    • FWMIG-Report.ps1 — Migration coverage + conflict report (READ-ONLY)
    • FWMIG-Set-MigrationRingTargeting.ps1 — Create/populate the migration ring Entra groups (Microsoft Graph)
    • FWMIG-Validation.ps1 — Post-migration firewall rule-parity check (READ-ONLY)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
